newsitem.title: THAILAND: Siam Commercial Bank cuts deposit rates.
newsitem.headline: Siam Commercial Bank cuts deposit rates.

text.p: A major Thai bank, Siam Commercial Bank Plc, said on Tuesday it cut its fixed deposit rates by 25 basis points with immediate effect.
After the reduction, the banks' interest rates on fixed deposits would range between 8.50 and 9.50 percent, it said in a statement.
Interest rates on saving deposits remained unchanged at 4.00 and 5.00 percent, it added.
Siam Commercial Bank on Monday also cut its minimum lending rate (MLR) by 25 basis points to 13.00 percent.
